## Domain problem formulation


## Data source overview



## Step 1: Review background information {#sec-bg-info}

- Debt (IMF): Gross general government debt as a share of GDP. The values come from the IMF. The data is sparse for early years and for developing countries. Missing values are recorded as a string saying "no data"

- Growth (World Bank): The annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices, based on local currency, real growth in other words. Aggregates are based on constant 2015 USD.

- Observational units: The observational unit for both datasets is a country-year

### Data dictionary

- debt.xls is a wide formatted excel spreadsheet containing one row per country and one column per year with each observation being a country's debt in a given year

- growth.csv is also wide formatted with the same observational unit, but contains real GDP growth and a few other unimportant variables (country code, indicator code, indicator name)


## Step 2: Loading in the data
```{r}
library("readxl")
library(tidyverse)

# Read in debt dataset
debt <- read_excel("./data/debt.xls", sheet = 1) |>
  rename(country = 1)

# Inspect
dim(debt)
head(debt)
```

```{r}
# Read in growth dataset
growth <- read_csv("./data/growth.csv")

# Inspect
dim(growth)
head(growth)
```

```{r}
# Filter years pre-1960 out
debt_1960 <- debt |>
  select(country, `1960`:`2015`)
```


## Step 3: Examine the data and create action items

### Finding invalid values
```{r}
# Transform debt data for inspection
debt_long_explore <- debt_1960 |>
  filter(!is.na(country)) |>
  mutate(across(-country, ~ as.numeric(na_if(as.character(.x), "no data")))) |>
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "year", values_to = "debt")

# Transform growth data for inspection
growth_long_explore <- growth |>
  select(country = `Country Name`, matches("^[0-9]{4}$")) |>
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "year", values_to = "growth")

# View descriptive statistic summaries of debt and growth datasets
summary(debt_long_explore$debt)
summary(growth_long_explore$growth)
```

### Assessing data completeness
```{r}
# Empty rows and non-data rows in the debt data
debt |> filter(if_all(-1, is.na))

# Does each country appear exactly once?
debt |> count(country) |> filter(n > 1)
growth |> count(`Country Name`) |> filter(n > 1)

# Which entries are not actual countries?
debt |>
  filter(str_detect(country, "G-20|Income|Union|IMF"))
growth |>
  filter(`Country Name` %in% c("World", "High income", "Low income",
                               "Sub-Saharan Africa", "European Union",
                               "OECD members", "Small states")) |>
  select(1:2)

# Country names with trailing whitespace
debt |>
  filter(country != str_trim(country)) |>
  pull(country)
```


## Step 4: Clean and pre-process the data

```{r}
cleanDebt <- function(debt_data, min_year = 1960) {
  debt_data |>
    # Remove the empty row and the copyright footnote row
    filter(!is.na(country), !str_detect(country, "IMF")) |>
    # Remove leading/trailing whitespace from the country names
    mutate(country = str_trim(country)) |>
    # Replace "no data" with NA and convert every year column to numeric
    mutate(across(-country, ~ as.numeric(na_if(as.character(.x), "no data")))) |>
    # Convert to long format
    pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "year", values_to = "debt_pct_gdp") |>
    # Convert year to an integer and keep only the years we need
    mutate(year = as.integer(year)) |>
    filter(year >= min_year)
}

# Clean debt dataset
debt_clean <- cleanDebt(debt)

# Inspect country-year observations of Australia in 1960's
debt_clean |>
  filter(country == "Australia", year <= 1969)
```

```{r}
cleanGrowth <- function(growth_data, min_year = 1960, max_year = 2021) {
  growth_data |>
    # Keep the country name and the year columns only
    select(country = `Country Name`, matches("^[0-9]{4}$")) |>
    # Convert to long format
    pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "year", values_to = "growth_pct_gdp") |>
    # Convert year to an integer and keep only the years we need
    mutate(year = as.integer(year)) |>
    filter(year >= min_year, year <= max_year)
}

# Clean growth dataset
growth_clean <- cleanGrowth(growth)

# Inspect country-year observations of Australia in 1960's
growth_clean |>
  filter(country == "Australia", year <= 1969)
```

```{r}
preprocessData <- function(debt_clean, growth_clean) {

  # Mapping of IMF country name to World Bank country name
  imf_to_wb <- c(
    "China, People's Republic of"      = "China",
    "Congo, Dem. Rep. of the"          = "Congo, Dem. Rep.",
    "Congo, Republic of"               = "Congo, Rep.",
    "Czech Republic"                   = "Czechia",
    "Côte d'Ivoire"                    = "Cote d'Ivoire",
    "Egypt"                            = "Egypt, Arab Rep.",
    "Hong Kong SAR"                    = "Hong Kong SAR, China",
    "Iran"                             = "Iran, Islamic Rep.",
    "Korea, Republic of"               = "Korea, Rep.",
    "Lao P.D.R."                       = "Lao PDR",
    "Micronesia, Fed. States of"       = "Micronesia, Fed. Sts.",
    "Puerto Rico"                      = "Puerto Rico (US)",
    "Saint Kitts and Nevis"            = "St. Kitts and Nevis",
    "Saint Lucia"                      = "St. Lucia",
    "Saint Vincent and the Grenadines" = "St. Vincent and the Grenadines",
    "South Sudan, Republic of"         = "South Sudan",
    "Syria"                            = "Syrian Arab Republic",
    "São Tomé and Príncipe"            = "Sao Tome and Principe",
    "Turkey"                           = "Turkiye",
    "Venezuela"                        = "Venezuela, RB",
    "Vietnam"                          = "Viet Nam",
    "Yemen"                            = "Yemen, Rep."
  )

  # IMF entries that are country groups rather than countries
  imf_aggregates <- c("G-20 Advanced", "G-20 Emerging", "Low Income",
                      "Eastern Caribbean Currency Union")

  debt_renamed <- debt_clean |>
    filter(!(country %in% imf_aggregates)) |>
    mutate(country = if_else(country %in% names(imf_to_wb),
                             unname(imf_to_wb[country]),
                             country))

  # Keep only the country-years that appear in both datasets
  inner_join(debt_renamed, growth_clean, by = c("country", "year")) |>
    arrange(country, year)
}

# Call preprocessing function on joined dataset
growth_debt <- preprocessData(debt_clean, growth_clean)

# Inspect country-year observations of Australia in 1960's
growth_debt |>
  filter(country == "Australia", year <= 1969)
```


```{r}

```
